summary: SI-Replace with input data does not properly work.

comments.content: What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. Use data input card and enter first 16 chromosomes of human DNA (5BDFE293BA5500F9) or any other data for SI-Replace card. 2. No longer relevant with new DNA changes, I say nuke this badboy
